name: Gahar
title: Temple Servant Who Returned from Exile
summary: Gahar was the ancestor of a family of Nethinim (temple servants) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile. His descendants are mentioned in the lists of those who returned with Zerubbabel. The temple servants played an important role in supporting the Levites in the temple service.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Ancestors of the Temple Servants in Ezra
keyEvents.description: Gahar's descendants are mentioned among the Nethinim (temple servants) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem under Zerubbabel's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Ancestors of the Temple Servants in Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Gahar's family is again mentioned in Nehemiah's list of those who returned from exile, confirming the family's role among the temple servants.

keyEvents.title: The Return of the Temple Servants to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Along with other families of temple servants, Gahar's descendants returned to resume service at the rebuilt temple in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Restoration of the Temple Service
keyEvents.description: The temple servants, including Gahar's descendants, played an important role in restoring the daily service at the temple after returning from Babylon.
